part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that `COMMAND GETKEYS` treated any getkeys result of 0 as "invalid arguments", but EVAL with 0 keys legitimately returns no keys.

Changes (mirroring upstream Redis PR #9733):
- `src/server.h`: added `CMD_NO_MANDATORY_KEYS` flag (`src/server.h:239`)
- `src/server.c`: parse the `no-mandatory-keys` flag string, document it, and add the flag to `eval`, `eval_ro`, `evalsha`, `evalsha_ro` in the command table
- `src/db.c`: `getKeysSubcommand` now returns an empty array instead of an error when the command has `CMD_NO_MANDATORY_KEYS` (src/db.c:1688)
- `src/module.c`: modules can declare `no-mandatory-keys` via `RedisModule_CreateCommand` flags

Verified: `command getkeys eval "return 1" 0` now returns an empty array; `unit/introspection-2`, `unit/introspection`, `unit/scripting`, `unit/sort`, `unit/moduleapi/getkeys`, and `unit/acl` all pass.
